narrative.intro: SLS Federal Services has $2.4B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. SLS Federal Services won 3 awards in the current fiscal year, with an average award size of $793M. All obligations reported in the provided period are recorded in FY26. The note clarifies that reported figures are contract obligations except where award values are identified as total contract values, and that current-year totals are partial because FY2026 is still in progress. The combination of a small award count and a high average award size explains why obligations concentrate in a single fiscal year. Readers should treat these numbers as fiscal-year-to-date totals rather than full-year results, and recognize that the record summarizes obligations and award counts rather than detailed agency or contract-line-item data.
